title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. we have masjid a/c in one bank and baitul mal a/c is another bank. in masjid a/c we have shops deposit amoutn and masjid income like (monthly subscriptions and shops rents) every 6 months we get interest. so we transfer the interest amoutn to baitul mal a/c. my question is can we transfer interest amoutn to baitul mal a/c or can we construct toilets in majsid premiss or can we paid interest amount to municipal property tax for shops. or can we use this interest amount for legal matters. my another question is Baitul mal is a halal amoutn like (Zakat and Fitr) can we mix the interest amoutn in that. because if we move the interest amoutn in to baitul mal a/c again after 6 month we get interest on (baitul mal a/c ). is it permissible ? if not can we create a fresh a/c in that only interest amout we deposit and we use needy people according to the situation. one more questions is Where do we use this interest amoutn can u please mail briefly so that we can follow inshallah. 2324 views Q. Can i buy car on installments through Non Banking Financial companies. 2678 views Q. Assalamualaikum, I had a factory which was closed down in 2001 because of sealing in delhi. Now the court has ordered me to pay compensation (on which they have charged interest) to the non muslim labourers who worked there.Since my financial position is not very good, I would like to ask whether i can pay this amount from the bank interest that has accumalated in my bank account or out of zakaat? Jazakallah 1590 views Q. Dear Mufti sahib! my father deposited some money in the bank in 1997/98, at that time he doesn't know much about the interest, later on in 2008 he realized that extra money that bank will give to him is interest. so he decided to give the money to the deserved peoples. but my father died in august last year. i want to know. (1): that all the money of interest will be given to the deserved onces. or we are also able to keep some money of interest. because at the time of the deposit the value of the money was much greater than it is now. (2): if we are not able to keep the money, then to whom it may be given. (3): can we give it to our poor relatives, if they also know that the money we giving to them is the money of interest. 1964 views Q. Helping the elders in getting the interest 1496 views Q. 1. Interest money for deceased non-muslim driver's family 2. Permission for setting up an atm machine 1737 views Q. I am a salaried person and company deducts income tax from our salary and pays it to the goverment. We have to submit a income tax certificate, which company gives us at the end of every financial year, to the goverment. I worked for two companies during April,2005 to March,2006 and I forgot to submit income tax certificate for the first company, althogh my company had deducted income tax from my salary and paid to indian government. I recived a notice from income tax department stating that I had to produce certificate of the first company within 7 days.Although I was late to produce it, but income tax official was demanding money as bribe to accept it and do necessary correction. Initially he was demanding Rs 10,000/- but later on Rs 5,000 was settled. Please let me know whether I can pay this bribe from haram money e.g. bank interest or there is any other way to do it. 2194 views Q. Can interest money be used to help a friend who has taken home loan to purchase a home? 1974 views Q. I intend buying a car using the islamic financing where the bank buys the car and they sell it to you at a profit but where iam not comfortable is that the bank insists i should get a comprehansive insurance which i do not want iam prepared to get the ordinary 3 rd party insurance which is compulsory by law.i feel the bank is protecting there interest but is this allowed? Can i go ahead and get comprehensive insurance as without that they do not sell me the car. 2229 views Q. I am working in private firm, this firm is engaged in assets valuation (present market value of houses, plots, shops, industrial units etc.) for banking purpose, bank finances to property holder after considering this valuation report, this firm is also engaged in insurance survey, suppose some one has taken insurance and suffered any losses then insurance companies handed over to our firm to prepare the estimate of loss and after considering this survey report insurance company pays compensation to person who has suffered the loss. My job in this firm is a computer operator I type this all survey reports and valuation report. Engineer?s of our firm also takes photographs of properties to be mortgaged in bank and damaged material which was surveyed by him, I have to save these photographs in computer and also make a CD of these photos and to reach this CD to photo shop for print-out. Kindly tell me this type of job is permissible in our Shariat or not. Please sir I am very confused. Please reply as soon as possible. 1508 views Q. I want to purchase the car on Loan from the Nationalised Bank. The bank will give the money directly to the Car Distributor. and the car Distributor give the car to me and I will pay in instalment to the Bank (with the amount Intrest) Is it permisible uner shariat Law or not? 2546 views Q. I have a property which i wish to get insured against fire and any natural calamity. Please advise if shariyat approves such action. 1605 views Q. Theres a firm which do halal business (construction and many others) as i have invested money in that firm and monthly they pay fix amount to me depending on how much investment made. 1672 views Q. Is the Government-Backed Insurance Scheme for Artisans Permissible in Islam? 2535 views Q. I want to take fatwa on the issue related to my sister married in Pakistan. Her husband died few months ago and he was working in a bank in Karachi. Now after his death the bank had given certain amount of money to my sister by saying that it is group Insurance money. But my brother in law never ever gave any amount no matter monthly, quarterly or yearly in the form of premium to the bank for this group insurance. The bank officials told that it is compulsory for all the employees working in that bank to take group insurance (which is provided free of cost by the bank to its employees) and the yearly premiums for that group insurance was being given by the bank and not by the employee. I will be highly grateful and thankful to you if can tell me (give fatwa) in the light of Islamic principles that the money is JAIEZ or HARAAM. Warm Regards? 3104 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 21153 Country: India Title: At Present I am Working in Pvt Ltd Co As an Accountant. I want to Know about Bank Job. Can Muslim Do Job In Bank or Insruance Company. Question: At Present I am Working in Pvt Ltd Co As an Accountant. I want to Know about Bank Job. Can Muslim Do Job In Bank or Insruance Company. Answer ID: 21153 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 466/466/M=1431) The job of writing and calculating interest based work in conventional banks and insurance companies is not lawful for a Muslim. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
